payload.blocks: Phase 7 follow-up steps 10-13 (landed-worktree removal, p-6sd4fslxv7); phases 2 step 10, 8, 9, 10 and 11 continue.
payload.headline: Widen heads-stable by apps/fgos/src/wiring/session_write_publish.rs so the landed-worktree removal compiles?

parts.cause: LandPorts gains an optional worktree_removal port. apps/fgos/src/wiring/session_write_publish.rs constructs LandPorts by struct literal at lines 307 and 399, so each needs 'worktree_removal: None'. That file is outside this plan's footprint.

options.cost: One footprint line and one short unit.
options.does: Add the file to the footprint; the unit adds 'worktree_removal: None' at the two literals, nothing else.
options.gain: The land removes clean landed worktrees, the disk-full cause of p-6sd4fslxv7, today.
options.harm: One more shared file; s6a may touch it, and the second lander rebases.
options.label: Widen footprint by session_write_publish.rs

options.cost: A redesign unit and a new test home.
options.does: Move the removal out of land.rs into the land verb's wiring in supervision.rs only.
options.harm: The owning proof leaves the land crate's tests and the removal stops being a land-door behaviour; a green change is redone.
options.label: Keep LandPorts unchanged

parts.recommendation: Widen footprint by session_write_publish.rs: two mechanical lines, and the design stays as the phase file states it.

scope.allows: Adding apps/fgos/src/wiring/session_write_publish.rs to this plan's footprint for the two LandPorts literals.
scope.forbids: Any other change to that file or to session-write behaviour.

parts.what: The land door's worktree removal is written and green in its crate (land 57/57, fgos-supervision 152/152), kept in reports/carry-p07c-landed-worktree-removal.diff. The fgos binary does not compile yet.
